about: Files of old trillion's port backlog (docs/worker-retirement-port-backlog.json) whose job is this tool's, moved here byte for byte from the tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire (commit), under their old paths so they import each other as they did. Only import paths differ: a request for a file this repository already holds names that file. A file that cannot load or pass here yet is held: its name ends in .held (the same bytes), and the README says what it waits for. Nothing here is wired into what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: wiring a file is adapting it, in a commit that names this receipt.
